rules.rule: ShopEase-fulfilled orders follow ShopEase return and refund policies. Seller-fulfilled orders may have seller-specific terms displayed on the product page.
conditions: Check 'Sold by' tag on product page
exceptions: ShopEase Assured items always follow ShopEase policy

rules.rule: Seller disputes are mediated by ShopEase Customer Protection within 5 business days. Wrong item, counterfeit, or missing items are eligible for full refund.
exceptions: Counterfeit complaints involve seller penalty review
